en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town with multi‑story buildings along the bank, small boats in the foreground, and a long iron bridge crossing the river. On the hill to the left are scattered houses and a small church-like building; in the distance to the right stands a large gothic cathedral complex with twin towers. The word "Meißen." is printed in red at the upper left, and the number "1931." is handwritten in red at the upper right.
